scope: Complete Agent5 original157-file evidence qualification, source publication and all final readbacks/checkers/failures, independent-review relay and description changes, and the bounded final ownership/queue delta. The separately preserved full native combination archive and frozen scout source archive are linked by their exact identities in the outer delivery packet.
selection_rule: All regular files recursively beneath the explicitly selected paths, including original inventories, failed attempts, and seals. No symlink, git repository, or unlisted directory is implicitly included.
archive_format: XZ-compressed POSIX PAX tar; one regular member per distinct byte sequence plus MANIFEST.json.
duplicate_policy: Every original relative path and its bytes/mode are recorded; identical bytes share a regular object member. No original path is dropped.
